body: AUDIT-7 Lane 4 disposition: `audit:partial`. This PR delivers the identity list, soft/hard block classification, rotation state and token minter. The daemon call path and live activation were left to follow-on #8017; later PR #11236 adds the daemon retry path, but live activation is still open pending an authoritative identity roster. The source issue #7948 closed despite its comment saying it should stay open. Lane 2 pointer: https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/13871#issuecomment-7161621192.
